# jamfplatform_device_erase (Action)

Requests that a device erase its content and settings. Requires **Device Management Actions API access**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_erase" "return_device_to_service" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-erase"

    # Optional erase request fields – remove or adjust as needed.
    preserve_data_plan       = true
    disallow_proximity_setup = false
    clear_activation_lock    = true
    return_to_service        = true
    pin                      = null
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `clear_activation_lock` (Boolean) Clear the activation lock on the device. Applies to mobile devices only.
- `device_id` (String) The ID of the device in UUID format. Provide this or `serial_number`.
- `disallow_proximity_setup` (Boolean) Disable Proximity Setup on the next reboot and skip the pane in Setup Assistant. Applies to mobile devices only.
- `pin` (String) The six-character PIN for Find My. Applies to computers only.
- `preserve_data_plan` (Boolean) Preserve the data plan on an iPhone or iPad with eSIM functionality, if one exists. Applies to mobile devices only.
- `return_to_service` (Boolean) The device will be returned to service after the erase is complete. Applies to mobile devices only.
- `serial_number` (String) Device serial number (case-sensitive). Requires **Device Inventory API access** when used. Provide this or `device_id`.
